description: Membaca nominal dari teks berantakan. Extracts a number from messy text: "Rp 1.250.000,-", "IDR 50k", "1,5 jt", "2.5M", "(Rp1.000)", "Total: Rp1.234.567,89" or words like "dua juta lima ratus ribu rupiah". Indonesian conventions first ("." thousands, "," decimal); ambiguities are reported.
name: parse_rupiah
title: Baca nominal Rupiah dari teks / Parse Rupiah
